evidence.claim: The company reports that its Datapod System integrates infrastructure from APC by Schneider Electric, including the APC Hot Aisle Containment System and InRow Cooling solutions, to achieve a Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) of less than 1.3, according to a Datapod technical overview.

The company reports that its modular system design reduces energy consumption by up to 50% compared to traditional brick-and-mortar data centers, a capability recognized by an industry design award as reported by Technology Decisions.

Power & Cooling Efficiency.assessed_on: We verified that the company's efficiency claims rest primarily on pre-engineered factory design thresholds and integrated partner infrastructure. Based on primary research, the company's operational PUE metrics can be estimated as superior, indicating optimal cooling efficiency, based on its partnership with APC by Schneider Electric utilizing their highly energy-efficient Hot Aisle Containment System and InRow Cooling solutions.

estimates.basis: its partnership with APC by Schneider Electric utilizing their highly energy-efficient Hot Aisle Containment System and InRow Cooling solutions
